runtime.command_template: python tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <libpinmame> --game ij_l7 --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --handle-mechanics 15 --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/wpc-dcs/ij-switch-edges-71.json --dmd-dir <external-dmd-dir> --output <external-run.json>. Each set_switch holds one public level for 2 s; the snapshot after it records the ROM's T.1 display and the watched public switch levels.

named_action_observations.label: public 76 (ordinary switch) set to 1 inside T.1 SWITCH EDGES: the ROM's top line names it (MINI MID. TOP RGT), so the ROM reads public 76 = 1 as active
public 76 (ordinary switch) set to 0 inside T.1 SWITCH EDGES: the ROM's top line returns to SWITCH EDGES, so the ROM reads public 0 as inactive
public 72 (opto normalized by ijGameData's mask) set to 1 inside T.1 SWITCH EDGES: the ROM's top line names it (MINI TOP HOLE), so the ROM reads public 72 = 1 as active
public 72 (opto normalized by ijGameData's mask) set to 0 inside T.1 SWITCH EDGES: the ROM's top line returns to SWITCH EDGES, so the ROM reads public 0 as inactive
public 71 (printed opto the mask does not normalize) set to 1 inside T.1 SWITCH EDGES: the ROM's top line names it (CAPTVE BALL FRNT), so the ROM reads public 71 = 1 as active
public 71 (printed opto the mask does not normalize) set to 0 inside T.1 SWITCH EDGES: the ROM's top line returns to SWITCH EDGES, so the ROM reads public 0 as inactive
public 73 (opto normalized by ijGameData's mask) set to 1 inside T.1 SWITCH EDGES: the ROM's top line names it (MINI BOTTOM HOLE), so the ROM reads public 73 = 1 as active
public 73 (opto normalized by ijGameData's mask) set to 0 inside T.1 SWITCH EDGES: the ROM's top line returns to SWITCH EDGES, so the ROM reads public 0 as inactive
